activity_statements.statement: governs and operates the premier professional baseball league in the US and Canada comprising 30 member clubs under the Office of the Commissioner
operates MLB.TV streaming platform delivering live and on-demand baseball games to fans globally, setting records in games and minutes watched
operates MLB Network cable television channel providing 24/7 baseball content, news and analysis to US households
licenses MLB intellectual property including marks, footage and photographs to consumer product companies, media organizations and international broadcasters
manages sponsorship and advertising relationships with corporate partners across 30-club marketing and media assets
maintains a global expansion program expanding reach of professional baseball through programming, content and international events

name_reality_gap: Labeled Entertainment Providers; MLB is more precisely a media rights and intellectual property monetization organization using baseball competitions as content — its primary revenue drivers are broadcast rights deals (billions), streaming (MLB.TV), licensing and sponsorship rather than gate revenues alone.
extraction_notes: About-MLB page is primarily contact/directory. Key business activities inferred from explicit mentions of MLB.TV, MLB Network, Licensing/Publishing, Sponsorship/Advertising and Footage Licensing departments. Source was lean on quantitative detail.
